answer: Sponsor debt is the turnstile: each hollow is a fake head; basalt is the sole registry binding key, endpoint and sponsor path, so twins collide. Entry k needs k unrelated sponsors from k disjoint basalt branches, one admission per epoch; every sponsor burns k fable into that hollow and is slashed if it merges. Thus n hollow cost sum k^2 fable, serial, not lendable. It breaks if basalt dedups weakly, sponsors are rented, or fable transfers.
